independent_interpretation.phase: The profile sampled actual snack owner construction including base-class owner source guard, canonical source physical boundaries and source-lane frame guards. Sampling does not prove which later stage dominates the full 1800-second V8 lifetime or that construction made particular progress; there is no timeline or full run completion.

credible_target.evidence: The actual profile shows sourceLane invoking base owner assertCurrent and its physical sweeps; checkedRead and canonical physical boundary generate material overlapping physical reads. The code shows per-frame guard calls plus nested owner-source guards whose own sourceLane.assertCurrent can invoke prior frame guards.
credible_target.direction: Research a single per-call nonrecursive guard composition which still executes each distinct owner predicate and validates each supplied/projection byte, rather than repeatedly entering an earlier frame guard via outer frame guards. Maintain callback-free cold physical/loaded-identity preflight, each scope’s live checks at relevant consumption boundaries, and a final trusted physical/absence sweep. Preserve unknown-reader rejection, exact private frame registry and public assertCurrent; no current/result/receipt cache or new external authority.
credible_target.status: Not yet a safe patch. Exact transitive guard graph, mutable captured identities, callback timing, population/absence checks and applicable immutable source attribution must be proved first; retain real cold and success→late tests. A leaf-only sweep substitution is a smaller testable change but observed I/O categories are broader and do not establish that it will meet deadline.
